description: Deterministic mutation testing and business-outcome contract auditing for AI agent evaluations across closed APIs and open-weights frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, DeepEval), with LatchGate runtime export.
rules: Run `mendmark demo` for a zero-credential local demonstration and `mendmark equip --framework auto --agent auto` to scaffold non-destructive repository setup files under `.mendmark/`.
Never convert observed agent traces into golden expected behavior without explicit human review, and redact credentials or personal data before saving fixtures.
Evaluate all four agent correctness surfaces (tool selection, arguments, execution outcomes/business invariants, and final response) rather than grading final text responses alone.

When the target agent runs on self-hosted open-weights models, run `mendmark export-latchgate <suite.json> --output pairs.jsonl` to compile a runtime residual-stream circuit breaker with `latchgate fit`.
